rules: asset_id unique within a package unless explicit multi-slot alias is defined in a future schema revision
source_sha256 and distribution_sha256 are lowercase or uppercase 64-hex digests
PUBLIC_RELEASE_SAFE may be placed on SIEZEALL shared distribution
FAMILY_PRIVATE_AUTHENTICATED must not be placed on a broadly shared/public package
INTERNAL_ONLY remains HNS/internal and cannot be distributed
Netlify filename/path is never asset identity authority
